objects.name: materialx
objects.description: A material of a MaterialX (.mtlx) document, with VisRTX's parameters (VISRTX_MATERIAL_MATERIALX); every other parameter overrides the selected material's shader input of its name (a value of the input's type, a sampler of any subtype, or an attribute name) or its texture input of that path (a file name or a sampler, see textureInputs)

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: A .mtlx document: a file path when sourceType is documentFile, or inline .mtlx XML text when sourceType is documentInline

parameters.name: sourceType
parameters.description: How `source` is interpreted: documentFile (default, a path) or documentInline (inline .mtlx XML text)

parameters.name: materialName
parameters.description: Optional. Selects a material within the document by name path or name (see the `materialNames` property). When unset, the first is used

properties.name: materialNames
properties.description: the name paths of the document's materials (those with a surface or volume shader), after a successful commit

properties.name: textureInputs
properties.description: the element paths of the selected material's filename inputs, which a file name or a sampler can replace, after a successful commit
